about: Desktop shell versions the current code needs, per platform (win32, darwin, linux).
required: below it the code package is not applied and the user must reinstall. Raise it only
when the new code cannot run on older shells (backend.js launch contract, bundled Python
version or dependencies, preload API the code relies on) and only for the affected platforms.
recommended: older shells still get the small code update and only see an optional hint to
reinstall. Use it for shell fixes and improvements that the code does not depend on.
